title: Token Sherpa: Compact Cost Slate & Exporter UI
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Design and prototype a compact, export-first token-level cost slate for Redwood Console. Deliverables: a responsive dashboard tile that surfaces per-invocation and per-session cost attribution, an inline breakdown ribbon for top contributors (prompts, model variants, routes), and CSV/JSON export flows shaped for chargeback systems. Emphasis on scanability for SREs and product managers, and minimal cognitive overhead for new users.
background: Customers asked for an exportable, compact view of token spend to integrate with internal chargeback tools and to quickly triage cost anomalies. This design consolidates attribution, quick filters (by route, model, time window), and a lightweight preview of line-item CSV structure.
user_stories: As a Platform PM I want a one-line summary and top-3 contributors so I can quickly assess high-cost routes.
As an SRE I want CSV exports with stable identifiers (route id, model id, invocation id) so I can join with logs.
As a Finance analyst I want pre-baked aggregation options (per-hour, per-customer) to import into billing reconciliations.
acceptance_criteria: Compact tile renders in Redwood Console Dashboard and matches spec in figma.
Exported CSV includes stable keys and column header versioning.
Filtering by route/model updates attribution ribbon within 300ms on mock data.
Design review feedback addressed and signed off by PM and Eng leads.
notes: We opted for a horizontal 'ribbon' layout to preserve vertical dashboard density. Trade-offs: some attribution context is hidden behind hover; plan to surface on-demand drill panels in followup. Chose CSV as default export format because customers already ingest CSVs into billing pipelines; JSONL offered for advanced users.

Success metrics: task completion rate >= 80%, median time to export < 90s, SUS score > 70.
